mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_HOSP_MST H WHERE H.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND H.ACTION_YN = 'Y') AS HOSP_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R WHERE R.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND R.REQ_STAT IN ('10','20') AND R.ACTION_YN = 'Y') AS REQ_CNT, (SELECT MAX(H2.HOSP_NM) FROM TBL_HOSP_MST H2 WHERE H2.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND H2.ACTION_YN = 'Y') AS HOSP_NM_DB

SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_USER_MST U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{email} AND U.ACTION_YN = 'Y') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_MEMBER_MST M WHERE M.EMAIL = #{email}) ) AS USER_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R WHERE R.EMAIL = #{email} AND R.REQ_STAT IN ('10','20') AND R.ACTION_YN = 'Y') AS REQ_CNT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_JOIN_REQ ( REQ_STAT, REQ_DTTM, HOSP_CD, HOSP_NM, HOSP_CEO, BUSI_NUM, ZIP_CD, HOSP_ADDR, HOSP_EXTRADR, HOSP_TEL, HOSP_FAX, WARDCNT, OCS_COMPANY, OCS_USER_ID, OCS_USER_PW, HIRA_CERT_PW, PC_USE_GB, PC_USE_TIME, PC_USE_STDT, ASQ_DAY, ASQ_BIGO, EVAL_GOAL, CONACT_GB, EMAIL, PASS_WD, MBR_NM, JOB_NM, MBR_TEL, BIGO, SEAL_IMG, SEAL_MIME, SEAL_NM, SEAL_HASH, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP, UPD_DTTM, UPD_USER, UPD_IP ) VALUES ( '10', NOW(), TRIM(#{hospCd}), #{hospNm}, #{hospCeo}, #{busiNum}, #{zipCd}, #{hospAddr}, #{hospExtradr}, #{hospTel}, #{hospFax}, NULLIF(TRIM(IFNULL(#{wardcnt},'')),''), /* 전산프로그램 정보(MASTER) · 심평원 인증서암호 — 기존 계약정보(TBL_HOSPCONT_MST)와 같은 항목·같은 방식으로 담는다. 승인 시 이 값들을 계약정보로 옮긴다. */ #{ocsCompany}, #{ocsUserId}, #{ocsUserPw}, #{hiraCertPw}, #{pcUseGb}, #{pcUseTime}, REPLACE(IFNULL(#{pcUseStdt},''),'-',''), #{asqDay}, #{asqBigo}, #{evalGoal}, #{conactGb}, TRIM(#{email}), #{passWd}, #{mbrNm}, #{jobNm}, #{mbrTel}, #{bigo}, /* 대표자 직인 — 화면이 base64 본문만 보내므로 FROM_BASE64 로 되돌려 담는다. 빈 문자열이면 NULL 로(빈 blob 을 만들지 않는다). */ FROM_BASE64(NULLIF(IFNULL(#{sealImg},''),'')), #{sealMime}, #{sealNm}, #{sealHash}, 'Y', NOW(), TRIM(#{email}), #{regIp}, NOW(), TRIM(#{email}), #{regIp} )

INSERT INTO TBL_JOIN_AGREE ( REQ_NO, AGREE_CD, VER_NO, AGREE_YN, READ_YN, AGREE_DTTM, AGREE_IP, AGREE_NM, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, UPD_DTTM, UPD_USER ) VALUES ( #{reqNo}, #{agreeCd}, #{verNo}, #{agreeYn}, #{readYn}, NOW(), #{agreeIp}, #{agreeNm}, NOW(), #{regUser}, NOW(), #{regUser} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE VER_NO = VALUES(VER_NO), AGREE_YN = VALUES(AGREE_YN), READ_YN = VALUES(READ_YN), AGREE_DTTM = NOW(), AGREE_IP = VALUES(AGREE_IP), UPD_DTTM = NOW(), UPD_USER = VALUES(UPD_USER)
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REQ_NO, R.REQ_STAT, (SELECT D.SUB_CODE_NM FROM TBL_CODE_DTL D WHERE D.CODE_GB='Z' AND D.CODE_CD='REQ_STAT' AND D.SUB_CODE=R.REQ_STAT) AS REQ_STAT_NM, R.HOSP_CD, R.HOSP_NM, R.HOSP_CEO, R.HOSP_TEL, R.EMAIL, R.MBR_NM, R.MBR_TEL, R.CONACT_GB, DATE_FORMAT(R.REQ_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REQ_DTTM, DATE_FORMAT(R.CFM_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CFM_DTTM, R.CFM_USER, R.RJT_RSN, CASE WHEN R.SEAL_IMG IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS SEAL_NM, /* 도장 유무만 목록에 */ /* 계약 존재 여부 — [계약입력]↔[계약수정] 라벨 분기용(2026-08-24) */ CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TBL_HOSPCONT_MST H WHERE H.HOSP_CD = R.HOSP_CD AND H.ACTION_YN = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CONT_YN , R.ACTION_YN AS actionYn FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R WHERE 1 = 1
AND R.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND R.REQ_STAT IN ('30','40') AND R.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND R.REQ_STAT = #{reqStat}
AND ( R.HOSP_CD LIKE CONCAT('%',#{hospCd},'%') OR R.HOSP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{hospCd},'%') OR R.EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%',#{hospCd},'%') )
ORDER BY R.REQ_NO DESC

SELECT R.REQ_NO, R.REQ_STAT, (SELECT D.SUB_CODE_NM FROM TBL_CODE_DTL D WHERE D.CODE_GB='Z' AND D.CODE_CD='REQ_STAT' AND D.SUB_CODE=R.REQ_STAT) AS REQ_STAT_NM, R.HOSP_CD, R.HOSP_NM, R.HOSP_CEO, R.BUSI_NUM, R.ZIP_CD, R.HOSP_ADDR, R.HOSP_EXTRADR, R.HOSP_TEL, R.HOSP_FAX, R.WARDCNT, R.OCS_COMPANY, R.OCS_USER_ID, CAST(R.OCS_USER_PW AS CHAR) AS OCS_USER_PW, CAST(R.HIRA_CERT_PW AS CHAR) AS HIRA_CERT_PW, R.PC_USE_GB, R.PC_USE_TIME, R.PC_USE_STDT, R.ASQ_DAY, R.ASQ_BIGO, R.EVAL_GOAL, R.CONACT_GB, R.EMAIL, R.MBR_NM, R.JOB_NM, R.MBR_TEL, R.BIGO, /* 비밀번호는 단방향 암호화라 원문을 꺼낼 수 없다 — 설정 여부만 본다 */ CASE WHEN R.PASS_WD IS NULL OR LENGTH(R.PASS_WD)=0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS PASS_YN, TO_BASE64(R.SEAL_IMG) AS SEAL_IMG, R.SEAL_MIME, R.SEAL_NM, R.SEAL_HASH, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TBL_HOSPCONT_MST H WHERE H.HOSP_CD = R.HOSP_CD AND H.ACTION_YN = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CONT_YN, R.ACTION_YN AS actionYn, DATE_FORMAT(R.REQ_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REQ_DTTM, DATE_FORMAT(R.CFM_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CFM_DTTM, R.CFM_USER, R.RJT_RSN, R.REG_IP FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R WHERE R.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}

SELECT A.AGREE_CD AS agreeCd, A.VER_NO AS verNo, A.AGREE_NM AS agreeNm, A.FORM_NO AS formNo, A.ESS_YN AS essYn, A.AGREE_TEXT AS agreeText, A.SORT AS sort FROM TBL_AGREE_MST A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND A.VER_NO = (SELECT MAX(B.VER_NO) FROM TBL_AGREE_MST B WHERE B.AGREE_CD = A.AGREE_CD AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.ACTION_YN = 'Y') AND (A.START_DT IS NULL OR A.START_DT <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AND (A.END_DT IS NULL OR A.END_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) ORDER BY IFNULL(A.SORT, 999), A.AGREE_CD

SELECT M.MGR_GB, M.MGR_SEQ, M.DEPT_NM, M.JOB_NM, M.MGR_NM, M.MGR_TEL, M.EMAIL, (SELECT D.SUB_CODE_NM FROM TBL_CODE_DTL D WHERE D.CODE_GB='Z' AND D.CODE_CD='MGR_GB' AND D.SUB_CODE=M.MGR_GB) AS MGR_GB_NM FROM TBL_JOIN_MGR M WHERE M.REQ_NO = #{reqNo} AND M.ACTION_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.MGR_GB, M.MGR_SEQ

SELECT A.AGREE_CD, A.VER_NO, A.AGREE_YN, A.READ_YN, A.AGREE_IP, A.AGREE_NM, DATE_FORMAT(A.AGREE_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS AGREE_DTTM, M.AGREE_NM AS AGREE_NM_TXT, M.FORM_NO, M.ESS_YN, M.AGREE_TEXT AS CONTENTS FROM TBL_JOIN_AGREE A LEFT JOIN TBL_AGREE_MST M ON M.AGREE_CD = A.AGREE_CD AND M.VER_NO = A.VER_NO WHERE A.REQ_NO = #{reqNo} ORDER BY IFNULL(M.SORT,999), A.AGREE_CD
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_HOSP_MST H WHERE H.HOSP_CD = (SELECT R.HOSP_CD FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R WHERE R.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}) AND H.ACTION_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_HOSP_MST ( HOSP_CD, JOB_SEQ, HOSP_NM, HOSP_ADDR, HOSP_EXTRADR, HOSP_CEO, BUSI_NUM, ZIP_CD, HOSP_TEL, HOSP_FAX, START_DT, END_DT, JOIN_DT, ACCEPT_DT, USE_YN, ACTION_YN, WARDCNT, HOSP_UUID, WINNER_YN, HOS_GRD, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP ) SELECT R.HOSP_CD, 1, R.HOSP_NM, R.HOSP_ADDR, R.HOSP_EXTRADR, R.HOSP_CEO, R.BUSI_NUM, R.ZIP_CD, R.HOSP_TEL, R.HOSP_FAX, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d'), '20991231', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d'), DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d'), /* 종별등급은 기본 '병원'(3). 담당자가 병원정보에서 바꾼다(2026-08-19). */ 'Y', 'Y', R.WARDCNT, UUID(), 'N', '3', NOW(), #{cfmUser}, #{regIp} FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R WHERE R.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}

INSERT INTO TBL_USER_MST ( HOSP_CD, USER_ID, JOB_SEQ, USER_NM, START_DT, END_DT, MAIN_GU, PASS_WD, PASS_CDT, EMAIL, USER_TEL, USE_YN, MBR_JOIN, HOSP_UUID, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP ) SELECT R.HOSP_CD, R.EMAIL, 1, R.MBR_NM, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d'), '20991231', '3', R.PASS_WD, CURDATE(), R.EMAIL, R.MBR_TEL, 'Y', 'Y', H.HOSP_UUID, 'Y', NOW(), #{cfmUser}, #{regIp} FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R JOIN TBL_HOSP_MST H ON H.HOSP_CD = R.HOSP_CD AND H.ACTION_YN = 'Y' WHERE R.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}

INSERT INTO TBL_MEMBER_MST ( HOSP_CD, EMAIL, HOSP_NM, PASS_WD, MBR_NM, JOB_NM, MBR_TEL, USER_ID, USE_YN, HOSP_UUID, JOIN_DT, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP ) SELECT R.HOSP_CD, R.EMAIL, R.HOSP_NM, R.PASS_WD, R.MBR_NM, R.JOB_NM, R.MBR_TEL, R.EMAIL, 'Y', H.HOSP_UUID, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d'), NOW(), #{cfmUser}, #{regIp} FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R JOIN TBL_HOSP_MST H ON H.HOSP_CD = R.HOSP_CD AND H.ACTION_YN = 'Y' WHERE R.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}

INSERT INTO TBL_HOSPSIGN_MST (HOSP_CD, SIGN_GB, SIGN_YN, SIGN_USER_ID, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) SELECT R.HOSP_CD, IFNULL(M.SIGN_GB, A.AGREE_CD), A.AGREE_YN, R.EMAIL, NOW(), #{cfmUser}, #{regIp} FROM TBL_JOIN_AGREE A JOIN TBL_JOIN_REQ R ON R.REQ_NO = A.REQ_NO LEFT JOIN TBL_AGREE_MST M ON M.AGREE_CD = A.AGREE_CD AND M.VER_NO = A.VER_NO WHERE A.REQ_NO = #{reqNo} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SIGN_YN = VALUES(SIGN_YN), UPD_DTTM = NOW(), UPD_USER = VALUES(REG_USER)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_JOIN_REQ R JOIN TBL_HOSP_MST H ON H.HOSP_CD = R.HOSP_CD AND H.ACTION_YN = 'Y' JOIN TBL_USER_MST U ON U.HOSP_CD = R.HOSP_CD AND U.USER_ID = R.EMAIL AND U.ACTION_YN = 'Y' SET R.REQ_STAT = '30', R.CFM_HOSP_CD = H.HOSP_CD, R.CFM_HOSP_SEQ = H.JOB_SEQ, R.HOSP_UUID = H.HOSP_UUID, R.CFM_USER_ID = U.USER_ID, R.CFM_USER_SEQ = U.JOB_SEQ, R.CFM_START_DT = U.START_DT, R.CFM_DTTM = NOW(), R.CFM_USER = #{cfmUser}, R.UPD_DTTM = NOW(), R.UPD_USER = #{cfmUser}, R.UPD_IP = #{regIp} WHERE R.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
UPDATE TBL_JOIN_REQ SET REQ_STAT = '90', RJT_RSN = #{rjtRsn}, CFM_DTTM = NOW(), CFM_USER = #{cfmUser}, UPD_DTTM = NOW(), UPD_USER = #{cfmUser}, UPD_IP = #{regIp} WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.select: SELECT REQ_STAT FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND REQ_STAT IN ('10','20')

SELECT R.REQ_NO AS reqNo , R.REQ_STAT AS reqStat , R.DOC_YN AS docYn , DATE_FORMAT(R.DOC_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS docDttm , R.DOC_FILE_NM AS docFileNm , R.HOSP_CD AS hospCd , R.HOSP_NM AS hospNm , R.HOSP_CEO AS hospCeo , R.BUSI_NUM AS busiNum , R.ZIP_CD AS zipCd , R.HOSP_ADDR AS hospAddr , R.HOSP_EXTRADR AS hospExtradr , R.HOSP_TEL AS hospTel , R.HOSP_FAX AS hospFax , R.WARDCNT AS wardcnt , TO_BASE64(R.SEAL_IMG) AS sealImg , R.SEAL_MIME AS sealMime , R.SEAL_NM AS sealNm , R.OCS_COMPANY AS ocsCompany , R.OCS_USER_ID AS ocsUserId /* ★2026-08-24 — OCS_USER_PW 가 빠져 있었다. 화면이 빈 값을 받아 <다음 저장이 빈 값으로 덮어> "입력해도 초기화"가 됐다. varbinary 라 hiraCertPw 처럼 CAST 로 내린다. */ , CAST(R.OCS_USER_PW AS CHAR) AS ocsUserPw , CAST(R.HIRA_CERT_PW AS CHAR) AS hiraCertPw , R.PC_USE_GB AS pcUseGb , R.PC_USE_TIME AS pcUseTime , R.PC_USE_STDT AS pcUseStdt , R.ASQ_DAY AS asqDay , R.ASQ_BIGO AS asqBigo , R.EVAL_GOAL AS evalGoal , R.CONACT_GB AS conactGb , R.EMAIL AS email , R.MBR_NM AS mbrNm , R.JOB_NM AS jobNm , R.MBR_TEL AS mbrTel , R.BIGO AS bigo , DATE_FORMAT(R.REQ_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS reqDttm , DATE_FORMAT(R.CFM_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS cfmDttm FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ R WHERE R.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND R.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND R.REQ_STAT IN ('30','40') ORDER BY R.REQ_NO DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND HOSP_CD = #{value} AND REQ_STAT = '30' AND DOC_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_HOSPCONT_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{value}
SELECT SEQ AS seq, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_TITLE AS fileTitle, FILE_SEQ AS fileSeq, FILE_GB AS fileGb FROM TBL_FILE_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{cfmHospCd} AND FILE_GB = 'C' AND FILE_SEQ = '1'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_FILE_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{cfmHospCd} AND FILE_GB = 'C' AND FILE_SEQ = '1'
DELETE FROM TBL_MEMBER_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{cfmHospCd} AND EMAIL = #{cfmUserId}
DELETE FROM TBL_USER_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{cfmHospCd} AND USER_ID = #{cfmUserId} AND JOB_SEQ = #{cfmUserSeq}
DELETE FROM TBL_HOSP_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{cfmHospCd} AND JOB_SEQ = #{cfmHospSeq} AND HOSP_UUID = #{hospUuid}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_JOIN_REQ SET REQ_STAT = '10', /* 제출 표시도 함께 되돌린다 — 올렸던 파일은 롤백이 지우므로 'Y' 로 남겨두면 다시 승인해도 제출화면이 뜨지 않는다(2026-08-19). */ DOC_YN = 'N', DOC_DTTM = NULL, DOC_FILE_NM = NULL, CFM_HOSP_CD = NULL, CFM_HOSP_SEQ = NULL, CFM_USER_ID = NULL, CFM_USER_SEQ = NULL, CFM_START_DT = NULL, CFM_DTTM = NULL, CFM_USER = NULL, UPD_DTTM = NOW(), UPD_USER = #{cfmUser}, UPD_IP = #{regIp} WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo} AND REQ_STAT IN ('30','40')
mapper.select: SELECT REQ_NO AS reqNo , REQ_STAT AS reqStat , HOSP_CD AS hospCd , HOSP_NM AS hospNm , CFM_HOSP_CD AS cfmHospCd , CFM_HOSP_SEQ AS cfmHospSeq , CFM_USER_ID AS cfmUserId , CFM_USER_SEQ AS cfmUserSeq , HOSP_UUID AS hospUuid FROM TBL_JOIN_REQ WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_JOIN_REQ SET REQ_STAT = '10', RJT_RSN = NULL, CFM_DTTM = NULL, CFM_USER = NULL, UPD_DTTM = NOW(), UPD_USER = #{cfmUser}, UPD_IP = #{regIp} WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo} AND REQ_STAT = '90'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CONACT_GB FROM TBL_HOSPCONT_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{value} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_JOIN_REQ SET ACTION_YN = 'N', UPD_DTTM = NOW(), UPD_USER = #{cfmUser}, UPD_IP = #{regIp} WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo} AND REQ_STAT = '10' AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'
UPDATE TBL_JOIN_MGR SET ACTION_YN = 'N' WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
